viz.oracle: simulator oracle: not observable on hardware

loading.aria: Loading the extension: each loaded stage adds one gate column to a five-qubit circuit
loading.caption: each column is one real loading stage · outcomes are Born-rule samples of this circuit
loading.sampled: {ket} · one Born-rule sample of the circuit above

orientation.aria: Orientation: a Bloch sphere revealed as one point in a lattice representing a growing state space
orientation.c1: One qubit: a point on (or inside) the Bloch sphere.
orientation.c2: n qubits need 2ⁿ complex amplitudes: the state space doubles with every qubit added.
orientation.c3: Each point here stands for one basis state. The lattice is a metaphor, not data.
orientation.metaphor: decoration · the lattice is a metaphor for 2ⁿ growth, not a simulation

stateSpace.aria: Amplitudes of the computational-basis states as pillars: height is probability, colour is phase

bloch.aria: Reduced single-qubit Bloch vectors with mutual-information filaments between qubits

tiling.aria: Stabilizer generators as tiles over the data qubits, lit when the expectation value is −1

lattice.aria: Distance-3 rotated surface code: nine data qubits, X and Z plaquettes, logical operators as strings
lattice.caption: d = 3 rotated surface code · tiles lit = stabilizer measured −1

threshold.aria: Logical versus physical error rate with 95% Wilson intervals

hist.aria: Histogram of measurement outcomes with Born-rule expectations

mi.aria: Pairwise mutual information heatmap in bits

raster.aria: Syndrome history: rounds by ancilla, lit cells measured 1

freeze.aria: Reduced density matrix of the data qubits across one syndrome-extraction step
freeze.caption: simulator oracle · between gates the display interpolates; the physics happens at discrete gates
freeze.frozen: frozen at {gate}: the off-diagonal coherences between syndrome sectors are gone, because that entangling gate copied the error's parity into an ancilla. The error is now either there or not. Nothing has been measured yet.
freeze.measured: The ancilla measurements only select which branch we are in: the data state is the projected branch state, and the decoder can now fix a plain Pauli error.
